title: Joyful Turkish Haddock Grill
description: A floral, light solo-dinner Turkish dish featuring haddock with a low-sodium miso-marinate and grilled to perfection, served with a citrusy sumac relish.
instructions: Combine miso paste, soy sauce, honey, cumin, coriander, lemon juice, minced garlic, and olive oil in a bowl to make a smooth marinate.
Place haddock fillets in the marinate, turning to coat each side, and refrigerate for 20 minutes to infuse flavors.
Preheat a grilling pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil the surface with a teaspoon of olive oil.
Remove fillets from the marinate, letting excess drip off, and place them on the hot grill.
Grill each side for 3 to 4 minutes until the fish flakes easily and develops a light char.
Transfer grilled fillets to a serving plate and drizzle with a squeeze of fresh lemon and a sprinkle of sumac.
Garnish with chopped dill and serve immediately for a bright, floral finish.
Enjoy the airy, low-sodium Turkish-inspired haddock with an effortless grill technique.
